title: 1721 Prairie: a two-storey brick stable on the railway's slant
items: The one-storey box behind 1721 Prairie is now a two-storey brick stable, slanted the way the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it, its long walls following the Illinois Central tracks. Carriage doors, a loft hatch and stable windows face the house's yard; its south wall, which the map marks as a fire wall, has none. An 1886 atlas marks a brick stable in the same place. The doors, windows and roof are reconstructed.
